'''''Canistropsis burchellii''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[genus]] ''[[Canistropsis]]''.

This [[bromeliad]] is [[endemic]] to the [[Atlantic Forest|Atlantic Forest biome]] (''Mata Atlantica Brasileira'') within [[São Paulo (state)]], located in southeastern [[Brazil]].

==Cultivars and hybrids==
* × ''Aechopsis'' 'Newk'
* × ''Neostropsis'' 'Fanfare'
* × ''Neostropsis'' 'Shadeball'
